sources.supports: General non-clinical undergraduate teaching, reading week and add/drop dates; faculty confirmation applies.
Programme-specific teaching dates and reading-week exceptions; Business and Economics postgraduate curricula excluded from this calendar.
Gazetted general holidays for 2026, including every Sunday.

interpretation: Calendar flags are review signals. The ordinary-weekday screen selects a bounded comparison subset; it does not establish cancellation of other source sessions or confirm programme-specific teaching.
exceptions_to_check: Business and Economics postgraduate curricula have separate dates.
MA(AppliedLinguistics) reading week is October 26-31, unlike the general October 12-17 week.
Clinical and several postgraduate curricula have different or no reading weeks.
Career/department fields alone do not uniquely identify the programme calendar for every class.
